Topic T1 · First Impression

The Part at a Glance
Item G4 on a millimeter grid: a ratcheting head on one end and a curved tail on the other.
The item’s 3D model from the SBS website — a long, slim strap with a small head at the bottom.

What You'd Notice Picking This Up Cold

Item G4 is a small black nylon cable tie: a flexible strap with a ratcheting head on one end. Feed the tail through the head and pull — it locks and holds.

Name

Pan-Ty Locking Cable Tie — a Panduit cable tie that bundles, secures and organizes wires or components.

Curved Style

The item specification lists the cable tie style as Curved, and the tail is bent at its end.

Material & Color

Plastic — Nylon 6/6, black, and described as weather resistant.

Cable ties as shown on the General Cable Ties category page.

The part number /PANDUPLT1MMO says nothing about the tie’s length or material — it points back to a supplier name and a supplier catalog number. See .

Reading a Part Number Like an Engineer

Not every SBS part number spells out its specifications. /PANDUPLT1MMO has a clear structure — a leading slash, a supplier prefix and the supplier’s own catalog number. This module follows the part from the website to the item record to the print.

Topic T2 · Part Number Decoder

Three Parts of a Part Number

Hover over any element of the part number below to see what it means — the same way SBS reads a new item, one piece at a time.

/PANDUPLT1MMO  =  3.9 PAN-TY LKNG CABLE TIE BLACK NYL 6/6
Panduit — the supplier named by the five letters after the slash.

Reading the Prefix

  1. The slash. Marks a catalog or print part.
  2. PANDU. The supplier prefix — the first five letters of the supplier’s name, Panduit.
  3. PLT1MMO. The supplier’s own catalog number, PLT1M-M0, with the hyphen dropped.
Reading the Item Description

3.9

The tie’s length in inches — it matches the 3.9″ length on the item specification.

PAN-TY LKNG CABLE TIE

The part type: a Pan-Ty locking cable tie. LKNG is short for locking.

BLACK NYL 6/6

The color and material: black Nylon 6/6.

PANDUIT # PLT1M-M0

The extended description adds the supplier catalog number, WEATHER RESISTANT and the pack size (1M/PK).1M/PK: “1M” is distribution shorthand for 1,000, so one pack holds 1,000 ties.

Topic T6 · Inspection

How the Part Is Checked Against Print

When a lot is inspected, the tie is measured against the catalog dimensions and the results are recorded on the SBS Inspection Report.

The Inspection Report
Click the report to enlarge.
The Inspection Report for /PANDUPLT1MMO: PPAP level 4, BRP # 293 750 001, with the catalog page attached.
1 · Burrs / Thread AestheticVisual
2 · MaterialNYL 6.6 — Visual / Document
3 · Surface Finish / ColorBLK — Visual / Document
4 · Length (F)99.00 mm — Caliper
5 · Width (B)2.25 – 2.75 mm — Caliper
6 · Thickness (A)0.85 – 1.35 mm — Caliper
7 · Tip StyleCurved — Visual
Report vs. Catalog

Inspection Report

The SBS report carries the PPAP level (4), part number, description and the catalog page, then one row per feature with its reference or min and max, its method, and sample columns for a Pass / Fail result.

Panduit Catalog Row

The dimensions come from the PLT1M row, in millimetres: nominal ± tolerance gives the report’s min and max.

Click a number on the inspection report to see exactly where that dimension and tolerance comes from in the Panduit catalog page.

1 · Length – F

Ref 99.00 mm (caliper).
Catalog column F, Length: 3.9 in (99 mm). The drawing marks it F REF., a reference dimension with no tolerance.

2 · Width – B

Min 2.25 / Max 2.75 mm.
Catalog column B: .098 (2.5 mm), with the drawing’s tolerance B ±.01 (.25) → 2.25 to 2.75.

3 · Thickness – A

Min 0.85 / Max 1.35 mm.
Catalog column A: .043 (1.1 mm), with the drawing’s tolerance A ±.01 (.25) → 0.85 to 1.35.

4 · Tip Style

Ref CURVED (visual).
Catalog column TIP STYLE: CURVED. The drawing shows both a straight tip and a curved tip.

The report’s feature / tolerance rows — the numbered pins match the catalog columns.
Panduit catalog, PLT1M row (F, B, A, tip style).

Material (Nylon 6.6) comes from the catalog page’s title block, and burrs and color are checked against the item specification, not a catalog column.

Visual & Document Checks

Burrs, material (NYL 6.6), color (BLK) and the curved tip are checked visually or against documents.

Caliper Checks

Length 99.00 mm; width 2.25–2.75 mm; thickness 0.85–1.35 mm.

Topic T8 · Applications

Where Locking Cable Ties Are Used

Cable ties turn up wherever wires, hoses or components need to be gathered and held in place.

Electrical

Bundling, securing and organizing wires.

Automotive

Routing and holding wiring and components in place.

Industrial

Organizing wires and components on equipment.

Everywhere Else

Anywhere a quick, reliable bundle is needed — the ratcheting head makes installation fast.

What a Cable Tie Does
  • Bundles and secures wires or components with a flexible strap.
  • Installs quickly — the ratcheting head gives reliable holding force.
  • Improves routing and reduces clutter.
  • Enhances safety by preventing movement or abrasion.

Wrap-Up

Reference

Glossary

Every code, acronym, and term used in this module, defined in plain language. Tap a term’s “jump” button to see it in context.

Cable Tie

A flexible strap with a ratcheting head, used to bundle, secure and organize wires or components. Feed the tail through the head and pull to lock it.

Catalog or Print Part

The leading “/” in the part number marks a catalog or print part — one specified by a supplier catalog number or a print.

COO (Confirm COO)

Country of origin. When Confirm COO is checked on the item record, the item’s origin is confirmed.

ERP / Item Maintenance

The SBS business system and the screen that shows how an item is set up — description, short code, extended description, item type and more.

Nylon 6/6

An engineering-grade polymer (polyamide) with an excellent combination of mechanical, thermal and chemical properties — the grade of this cable tie.

Panduit

The supplier behind this part. “PANDU” in the part number is the first five letters of its name, and PLT1M-M0 is its catalog number.

Pan-Ty

The Panduit name for its locking cable ties, as in 3.9 PAN-TY LKNG CABLE TIE.

PPAP

Production Part Approval Process — the documentation package a supplier submits to prove its process can reliably make a part to print. This item is at PPAP Level 4.

Catalog Print

For a catalog part, the supplier’s catalog page and the row for the part serve as the print.

Weather Resistant

Called out in the extended description — the tie is made to hold up outdoors and in harsher conditions.
